preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements n in each array must be between 1 and 50.
The sum s of elements in the array must be between 0 and 200.
The sum k of absolute differences between each pair of elements must be between 0 and 2000.

postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 indicating no valid array exists, or contain exactly n space-separated integers representing the array.
The sum of the elements in the output array must equal s.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(int(stdout.split()[i]) - int(stdout.split()[j])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) == k
postconditions.description: The sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements in the output array must equal k.
